spec.name: menu-gathering-of-the-broods
spec.prompt: Armies gathering beneath a giant magical forest before a battle: tension building to an epic swell. Pounding taiko and timpani, urgent staccato strings, low brass stabs, a solemn wordless choir, glittering harp and celesta for the forest's magic, a heroic trumpet and horn line at the climax. Fast tempo, C minor, cinematic fantasy orchestra. A 30-second instrumental piece for a fantasy real-time strategy game's main menu, made to loop: its last bars lead back into its opening so the restart is seamless. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only: no drum kit, no synth leads, no electronic or modern pop sound, no sung words.
